name: Image Reader
description: Reads screenshots with native vision — YouTube analytics, competitor channels, news articles, social posts, bills/lawsuits, infographics, industry/tracking data — extracts the figures, judges the trends, reads competitive positioning, and files Markdown + PDF reports to the Storage Library. Compiles 30–60 day research reports from the filed archive, transcribes voice notes so you can talk instead of type (natively in Slack), and delegates follow-up work to the other agents.
tagline: Reads your screenshots, hears your voice notes, briefs the team.

writes.description: Hands work to another agent (the reader's middle-man role). On Slack the specialist actually runs and replies in the same thread (capped at 3 per message, coalesced per agent); elsewhere it files a workspace task. Approval-gated agents (Publisher, Brand Manager, Community Manager) still pause for human approval; ungated paid work (b-roll rendering) is hard-capped per run.

Sends an ad-hoc plain-text email via Resend from the workspace's own address, only when the creator asks, with exactly the content and recipients they gave (CC supported). Capped at 10 recipients and 3 tool actions per message.
Saves an explicitly-stated fact to the workspace's long-term memory (agent_memory). Confirms exactly what was saved, or reports precisely why it couldn't be — it never claims a save it didn't make.
